data.title: Qualify Intelligence OS evidence and recorded owner context
data.body:
PR #6651 qualifies the existing Intelligence OS overview and engine-detail journey with five evidence bands, owner-recorded readiness, honest horizon and source limits, bilingual theme controls, and bounded read-only consumers. It adds no trading, promotion, or fleet-wide strict-gate authority.

Chris released HOLD-FOR-SOL in [the recorded decision](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/6651#issuecomment-6158644348). The existing merge-on-green controller owns the protected merge, including admitted base refreshes and fresh checks. Deployment and authenticated production verification follow through the normal updater.

The latest prepared integration merges main c3ade6fe509b6b3f0eb8bb0120d77a3574cf57e2 and preserves both parents' CI dependency additions in four conflicting lists. All 309 jobs remain. A real closure failure identified config/market_memory_factory_bindings.v1.json as one newly required A1 input; that exact path is now declared. A1 commands, dependencies, gate and all 17 qualified runtime file hashes are unchanged. Incoming owner source and generated output remain intact.

Validation:
- Prior published 2a4236dc89710cb86f6aab771f0eed073b34b978 completed CI38512444577 successfully: all 12 packs, contract-delta and ci-gate passed. Its plan selected 124 logical jobs, including the A1 owner. That prior-head success does not satisfy the new integration's checks.
- The local merged CI contract run passed 249 checks, skipped two documented sparse mockup checks, and exposed the single missing A1 dependency above. Both targeted post-repair coverage/selection checks passed with zero failures/errors/skips in 278.14 seconds.
- Actual committed-source inventory on 05a75a4131f5e695a1d31616ac9e2ecca6059c67 covers all 1,175 A1 inputs without omissions. Agent OS's curated closure is also complete; the QLedger job keeps its existing inferred scope. The new config path selects A1.
- Previously accepted 373-test isolated API/UI/measurement verification and the 42-state local browser matrix remain bound to unchanged runtime bytes. They establish local qualification, not production acceptance.

Delivery status is determined by the actual PR head and its checks. Merge, installed files/process, served asset hashes, real authenticated API and browser behavior, a natural subsequent owner update, and operator comprehension remain separate obligations. SCOPED_COMMISSION_COMPLETE=false; LEGACY_PROGRAMME_COMPLETE=false; PRODUCTION_PROVEN=false. The independent T5/T6/T12 follow-on remains on its separate source branch.

M02 (Options Intelligence programme, Terminal #599; WS-ADVANCED-DATA-OPTIONS) pins the SPX hedge-target assertions A02–A05 of the session-mechanics scenario surface with mutant-proven tests, stacked on the four Sol CEO commits of #8684 (`4b3b1dbbbe66`, `4e7e44bfcce3`, `78d68942de59`, `300754c60144`, all authored ≤ 2026-10-09T06:11:43Z).

This PR adopts #8684 unchanged and adds one commit:

- `fbb646b20087` `test(options): M02 pin #8684 hedge-target A02–A05 (mutant-proven)` — `tests/test_options_scenario_surface.py` +244 only.

Custody: the single custody claim on #8684 is the fence comment https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/8684#issuecomment-6117845161 (2026-10-12T04:38Z, D20 standard). #8684's head `300754c60144` was re-verified against `refs/pull/8684/head` before stacking. Once this PR merges, #8684 is superseded and should be closed by its author or the seat; no second writer touched its branch.

## Mutant proof (each mutant FAIL → restored PASS)

| assertion | mutant applied to `engine/options_scenario_surface.py` | failing test |
|---|---|---|
| A02 | `change = b1 - b0` → `abs(b1) - abs(b0)` | `test_endpoint_reversed_inventory_negates_target_change` |

Seat re-run (local, full dependency set): 409 passed across `tests/test_options_scenario_surface.py tests/test_thetadata_store.py tests/test_thetadata_resolver.py tests/test_options_matrix.py`; import OK.

## Overlap

#7328, #8555 (HOLD-FOR-SOL, untouched), #8851 (`engine/intraday_greeks.py`) and #8856 (`engine/thetadata_store.py`, `scripts/backfill_thetadata_eod.py`) do not touch the lane's file; `thetadata_store.py` is touched by #8684 itself — if #8856 lands first, the merge-on-green controller refreshes this head and reruns CI. Terminal #870 (head `dd0284581b78`) consumes the published payload and is unchanged.

## Finding (out of scope, not fixed here)

An unknown top-level CLI field reaches `scripts/build_options_scenario_surface.py:39` as an uncaught `TypeError`. Logged for a follow-up lane.

head_commit.message:
feat(cs-v2-l1a): registration-path integration with distinct predicates

Masterplan L1 row L1a (A10, A11, A20, A23). Adds
engine/capital_structure/registration_integration.py: one
capital_structure.registration_path.v1 record per lifecycle record, with
origin, amendment chain and intervals that keep valid time (SEC
acceptance) apart from house knowledge (mastermind_available_at), plus
eight distinct closed predicates -- filed, effect_observed,
automatic_shelf_form, automatic_effectiveness, offering_role, withdrawn,
replaced and shelf_window -- each separately evidenced, none of them
alone or combined an amount or an executable-offering claim.

offering_role and replaced stay unknown: primary versus resale is
accepted content evidence the lifecycle does not carry, Rule 415(a)(6)
carry-forward rows are fee-table rows no TERM_NAME extracts, and a
supersedes edge is event-version supersession, never a replacement. An
automatic shelf form is a form fact, never WKSI status. A shelf window is
conditional only on pack-qualified Rule 415(a)(5) text on the start date
plus an initial effectiveness date, and is a date bound with named
conditions, never an amount; a rule the pack does not cover on that date
answers unknown with a named reason.

Source selection fails closed (spec A.2): a precompiled bundle cannot be
re-cut to another house-knowledge cutoff, a recompile bound beside one
must match its records or be refused naming both digests, events bound
without event_edges refuse, and an edges ledger bound unavailable yields
an unavailable family. Includes two B.5 cross-tests against rule pack
1.1.0 from L1b, so this commit is stacked on #9359. Registers the suite
in the capital-structure-intelligence job and records the decision and
handoff.

Code written by fabric lane cs-v2-l1a-20261014T1438Z; reviewed,
repaired and committed by the O2 orchestrator.
